name: flow_join_link_waits_for_the_name
description: A friend's join link opened on a first launch (Session.open_link, what boot() does with play/?join= in the browser) waits for the name prompt: HELLO is the only message that carries a name, so the game connects only once the player has chosen one, and the party sees that name, not the generated placeholder. A player already named joins at once. The fake sequencer in lobby mode stands in for the official server.

steps.msg: a first launch asks for a name
nothing connects while the prompt waits for a name
the answer opens the link: the party it names
the server's PARTY_STATE (what every member sees) has the name chosen, not the generated one
named already, a link connects at once
